## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
<!-- Provide a clear, concise summary of what this change achieves -->

### Branching Strategy Context
- **Target Branch:** `develop` (for features/enhancements) or `main` (for releases/hotfixes)
- **Source Branch:** `feature/...` | `hotfix/...` | `chore/...`

### Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: A new feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix or patch
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates only
- [ ] `style`: Formatting, spacing, or CSS adjustments
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization without functional changes
- [ ] `ci` / `chore`: CI/CD configuration, git hooks, or dependency updates

### Verification & Testing Checklist
- [ ] Tested locally on desktop browser
- [ ] Verified zero JavaScript console errors
- [ ] Ensured all Conventional Commits standards are met
- [ ] Verified no lingering Git conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`)
- [ ] Responsive layout checked across mobile and desktop viewports

### Merge Strategy
- [ ] Fast-forward / Non-fast-forward (`--no-ff`)
- [ ] Squash and merge
